description: SalesEQ connects your meeting data to ChatGPT so you can find meetings, search conversations, review summaries and transcripts, inspect relevant video moments, and answer questions using your organization's meeting context.

defaultPrompt: Summarize the meetings I had this week and highlight the key decisions, action items, and open questions.
Review the meetings I had this week, identify which ones need follow-up, and draft a short follow-up email for each.
Compare all my client calls with my coworkers client calls and give me coaching on where I can improve.
